title: Abstract Kit Store and Create Studio Vscode Bundles
description: Abstract the Kit Store completely from sketchpad. Create a new compose bundle called studio that has the yjs kit provider. Pass it as a root prop to Sketchpad. Remove the yjs dependency completely from sketchpad. Create File store (JSON sync) and Folder store (sqlite sync). Create a compose vscode bundle that opens sketchpad when a JSON kit file is opened.
summary: Created @compose/studio bundle with Y.js re-exports and persistence providers (IndexeddbPersistence, JSON file, SQLite folder). Moved yjs imports from sketchpad to studio. Created separate @semio-tech/compose-vscode extension for kit.json editing with CustomTextEditorProvider. Reverted repo/vscode changes. All builds pass, all 22 tests pass.
